import re

def main():
    total_chars = int(input())
    input_string = input()

    pattern = r"\([a-zA-Z_]*\)"
    replaced_input = re.sub(pattern, "_", input_string)

    split_parts = re.split(r"_+", replaced_input)
    max_part_size = max((len(part) for part in split_parts), default=0)
    print(max_part_size)

    count_in_parentheses = 0
    inside_parentheses = False
    start_idx = -1
    end_idx = -1
    for i, c in enumerate(input_string):
        if c == '(':
            inside_parentheses = True
            start_idx = i
        elif c == ')' and inside_parentheses:
            inside_parentheses = False
            end_idx = i
            inner_content = input_string[start_idx + 1:end_idx]
            if inner_content:
                segments = re.split(r"_+", inner_content)
                count_in_parentheses += len(segments) - (1 if inner_content.startswith("_") else 0)
    print(count_in_parentheses)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
